نخترع (form VIII)
# نَخْتَرِعُ (naḵtariʕu) /nax.ta.ri.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# نُخْتَرَعُ (nuḵtaraʕu) /nux.ta.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# نَخْتَرِعَ (naḵtariʕa) /nax.ta.ri.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# نُخْتَرَعَ (nuḵtaraʕa) /nux.ta.ra.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
